'''Nasrabi''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] warrior-[[King of Mon Cala/Legends|queen]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] who lived sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Hall of Heroes (Dac)|Hall of Heroes]], a part of the [[Orotoru G'am Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Orotoru G'am]], contained a statue of Nasrabi<ref name="Strongholds" /> by [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of which the statue of Nasrabi was present in the [[Hall of Heroes (Dac)|Hall of Heroes]], take place eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|I}}, which corresponds to [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> The statue depicted the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Death|killing]] a wild [[Keelkana/Legends|keelkana]], a type of massive [[Eel/Legends|eel]] that lived on Dac.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
A statue of Nasrabi appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', developed by [[Rainbow Studios]].<ref name="Racer's Revenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref> The statue was first identified as Nasrabi in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
